meta.note: Conservative conflict-group draft for the 7-predicate construction predcls task. This version only targets the strongest observed semantic overlap pair in current evaluation: near vs next_to.

conflict_groups.rationale: The current predcls evaluation shows that near remains the weakest predicate while next_to is much stronger, indicating asymmetric confusion inside a shared proximity semantics space. Restricting conflict reentry to this pair gives a focused way to test whether recall can be shifted from the easier geometric label next_to toward the broader and harder label near without disturbing already-saturated predicates.
